column2: A scanner rebuilt with hypertech parts that works out the best module-bay layout for a machine. Double-click it, or right-click and choose Activate.

A Hypertech instrument built for one job: arranging modules. Nobody on the station can make one. Rumor has it the warehouse holding a whole shipment was recently raided, and now they are flooding the black market.

It's still hot, so it costs more than at the doctor's. I won't ask what you want it for, and you don't ask where it came from.
